lure: A relative abroad lost his wallet and asks for a favour
ask: Buy gift cards and send the codes, in secret

message.subject: Need a favor, please keep it between us
message.body: [name] I'm in Madrid and my wallet was stolen. Can you buy 4 Apple gift cards of $200 and send me the codes? Please don't tell Carol.

source.attribution: Prudence demo cases (Scam Shield), CC BY 4.0

verdict.headline: Be careful: this may not be Mark.
reasons: Gift-card codes are the payment scammers ask for.
The reply goes to another address; call Mark on his usual number.
